sources.note: Nothing. Section 1.3.1 'Phonology' (PDF pp. 6-8) is a general introduction to sign-language phonology (handshape, location, movement parameters; non-manuals) illustrated with ASL; the Berbey SL analysis concerns iconic strategies and lexical/phonological variants of 10 animal signs. No mention of stress, prosody, accent, rhythm or intonation anywhere in the text (grep of full text layer).
